column1: # One row per obligation.  `generalises` names the TIER-1 (Lower.sizeBounds / Lower.lenBounds,
# a syntactic interval per AST node) or TIER-2 (SizeZ3 / LenZ3, one ground `(declare-const n<i>
# Int)` per AST node) claim, or the instance-tier .smt2 obligation, that the row's schematic
# statement subsumes.  Neither of those tiers can quantify over inputs at all — that is the whole
# point of this directory; see _signature.p's header.
# Verdicts live in STATUS.tsv, written by run.sh.  Rows whose id starts with N are NEGATIVE
# CONTROLS: they are FALSE and must NOT be provable, and run.sh fails the run if one is proved.
# ONE PROVER.  There is no z3 column anywhere in this tier: the statements are quantified
# first-order sentences over uninterpreted sorts, and an SMT-LIB rendering would need
# `declare-datatypes` for `path`, which docs/traps.md 3 records vampire cannot consume — so the
# twin could not be cross-checked by the prover that actually discharges this tier.  The negative
# controls and run.sh's vacuity probe are the compensating checks.
# THE TRUSTED BASE OF THIS TIER IS ONE FILE: `_path_induction.p`.
# It is the STRUCTURAL INDUCTION SCHEMA for the free term algebra `path`, instantiated at one
# predicate.  A schema quantifies over formulas, so first-order logic cannot state it and a
# saturation prover has no rule for it; the instance is therefore asserted.  It says NOTHING about
# what `app` computes — the same instance is valid for any property of paths — and BOTH of its
# premises remain obligations, discharged as `mon_cancel_base` and `mon_cancel_step`.  It has no
# registry row because rows name CONJECTURE files and this is an axiom module; it is named here, in
# `run.sh`'s EXPECTED_OPEN comment, and in docs/atlas.md's acceptance contract.
# WHAT IT REPLACED.  `_cancel.p` used to ADMIT left cancellation of append itself — a domain fact
# about `app` — and `wrap_roundtrip` and `card_wrap` were reported PROVED while resting on it, with
# `mon_cancel` OPEN in EXPECTED_OPEN.  `mon_cancel` is now PROVED and `_cancel.p` is a re-asserted
# PROVED LEMMA (that file's header carries the measurement for why it is still re-asserted).
